docx_script = """import openpyxl
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT

# 1. Read the real inventory data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('testbed/data/product_inventory.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
headers = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]

products = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if any(cell is not None for cell in row):
        products.append({headers[i]: row[i] for i in range(len(headers))})

# 2. Compute summary stats
total = len(products)
categories = {}
prices = []
for p in products:
    cat = p.get('Category', 'Unknown')
    categories[cat] = categories.get(cat, 0) + 1
    prices.append(p.get('Price', 0))

min_price = min(prices)
max_price = max(prices)
avg_price = sum(prices) / len(prices)

# 3. Create Word document
doc = Document()

# Title
title = doc.add_heading('Product Inventory Summary', level=0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Overview paragraph
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
overview = doc.add_paragraph()
overview.add_run(f'This report summarizes the product inventory sourced from ')
overview.add_run('product_inventory.xlsx').bold = True
overview.add_run(f'. The inventory contains a total of ')
overview.add_run(f'{total} products').bold = True
overview.add_run(f' spanning {len(categories)} categories. ')
overview.add_run('All listed items are marked "In Stock: Yes."').bold = True

# Price summary
doc.add_heading('Price Summary', level=1)
price_para = doc.add_paragraph()
price_para.add_run(f'Price Range: ').bold = True
price_para.add_run(f'${min_price} - ${max_price}')
price_para2 = doc.add_paragraph()
price_para2.add_run(f'Average Price: ').bold = True
price_para2.add_run(f'${avg_price:.2f}')

# Category breakdown
doc.add_heading('Category Breakdown', level=1)
sorted_cats = sorted(categories.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
for cat, count in sorted_cats:
    doc.add_paragraph(f'{cat.title()}: {count} product(s)', style='List Bullet')

# Product details table
doc.add_heading('Product Details', level=1)
note = doc.add_paragraph()
note.add_run('Note: ').bold = True
note.add_run('All 15 products listed below are currently marked as "In Stock: Yes."')

table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=5)
table.style = 'Light Grid Accent 1'
table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER

# Table headers
hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    hdr_cells[i].text = h
    for paragraph in hdr_cells[i].paragraphs:
        for run in paragraph.runs:
            run.bold = True

# Table rows
for p in products:
    row_cells = table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = str(p.get('Product ID', ''))
    row_cells[1].text = str(p.get('Name', ''))
    row_cells[2].text = str(p.get('Category', '')).title()
    row_cells[3].text = f"${p.get('Price', 0)}"
    row_cells[4].text = str(p.get('In Stock', ''))

# Footer note
doc.add_paragraph('')
footer = doc.add_paragraph()
footer.add_run('All items are currently in stock and available for order.').italic = True
footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Save
doc.save('output/inventory_summary.docx')
print(f"Document saved: output/inventory_summary.docx")
print(f"Total products written: {total}")
print(f"Categories: {dict(sorted_cats)}")
"""
await write_file("./generate_docx.py", docx_script)
print("Script written")

await make_directory("./output")
